what: Remote hosts (ssh/sandbox) never ran a job. defaultHostTransport.run sends {id, files, outputs} with no command, and swarm-remote-exec (tools/remote-exec.mjs) waits forever when the request has no command and returns files: []. Found on 2026-10-14 by feeding the transport's real payload to remote-exec; it only ever passed with stub transports (tests/executors-run.test.mjs). dev2 later proved reachable over real ssh.
rule: A feature that talks to another machine is not done until a test runs it against a real host; stub transports prove only the scheduling around it.
fix: In the next phase PR: send the agent command and args in the request, run it remotely in the shipped workspace, return the declared outputs with sha256, and add a test against a real ssh host (dev2) that skips when no host is configured.
